snippet.title: What Happens to a Tablet After You Swallow It? 💊 | The Journey Through Your Body
snippet.description:
Have you ever wondered what happens to a tablet after you swallow it? 💊

In this 3D medical animation, follow the incredible journey of a medicine through the human body, from the moment you swallow it until it is absorbed, reaches its target, produces its effect, gets metabolized, and is eventually eliminated.

🔬 In this video, we explore:

• How a tablet travels through the esophagus
• What happens to it inside the stomach
• Tablet disintegration and dissolution
• Drug absorption in the small intestine
• How the drug enters the bloodstream
• The journey through the liver and first-pass metabolism
• How medicine reaches its target tissue
• Drug-receptor interaction and therapeutic effects
• Drug metabolism
• Kidney filtration and elimination

This video is created for educational purposes to help visualize pharmacokinetics and how medicines travel through the body.

Follow MedExplained for more easy-to-understand medical animations and health education.

snippet.title: What Happens After Embryo Transfer? 🔬 (Day by Day 3D Animation) #shorts #ivf
snippet.description:
ट्रांसफर के बाद के 14 दिन (Two-Week Wait) हर महिला के लिए बहुत नाजुक और स्ट्रेसफुल होते हैं। लेकिन क्या आप जानती हैं कि अंदर कितनी जादुई प्रोसेस चल रही होती है? ✨

इस 3D मेडिकल एनीमेशन में समझिए डे-बाय-डे प्रोसेस:
✅ Days 1-2 (Hatching): एम्ब्रियो अपने बाहरी शेल (Zona Pellucida) से बाहर आता है।
✅ Days 3-4 (Adhesion): एम्ब्रियो यूट्रस की लाइनिंग (Endometrium) से चिपकने की कोशिश करता है।
✅ Days 5-6 (Implantation & hCG): एम्ब्रियो पूरी तरह लाइनिंग के अंदर चला जाता है, माँ के ब्लड फ्लो से जुड़ता है, और प्रेगनेंसी हॉर्मोन (Beta hCG) रिलीज़ करना शुरू करता है!

यह सब आपके अंदर अपने आप हो रहा है, इसलिए अपनी बॉडी पर भरोसा रखें और बिल्कुल स्ट्रेस न लें। 💖

फर्टिलिटी और IVF से जुड़ी ऐसी ही साइंटिफिक जानकारी के लिए इस वीडियो को Save करें और चैनल को Subscribe करें!

snippet.title: What happens inside your body After You Eat  boiled Egg on an Empty Stomach
snippet.description:
What happens inside your body when you eat a boiled egg on an empty stomach? 🥚

Follow the incredible journey of a boiled egg as it travels through your digestive system—from your mouth and esophagus to your stomach, small intestine, and bloodstream. Discover how stomach acid and digestive enzymes break down egg protein, how nutrients are absorbed through the villi, and how amino acids, healthy fats, vitamin B12, selenium, and other nutrients are delivered throughout your body.

This realistic 3D anatomy animation explains the science of digestion using medically accurate visuals and easy-to-understand narration. You’ll also learn why boiled eggs are a rich source of high-quality protein and how they fit into a balanced diet.

If you enjoy learning about human anatomy, digestion, nutrition, and realistic medical animations, subscribe for more educational videos every week.
